businessDifference.conflictSummary: 直接接任务路径安装了 DialogInterest 并等待 PreparedAction，但没有武装已有五环 presence observation，导致生产者不可达。
businessDifference.userDecision: 按现有五环 Cloud PreparedAction 设计修复并在后台持续实跑；发现异常停止、修复后继续。

connectivity.producer: FiveRingTaskV2.acceptInitialDialogAndTriggerPathing 在 NPC Dialog 已打开后武装 exact observation-run 的五环 title/dialog presence 兴趣；Client WuhuanPresenceLocalMechanics 从共享周期帧产生 WUHUAN_DIALOG_PRESENCE。
connectivity.transport: Observation request 携带 exact taskRunId/windowId/HWND/observerSeq 的 WUHUAN_DIALOG_PRESENCE；CloudWindowObservationInbox 创建唯一 wuhuan-dialog FrameDemand，Client 回传 exact demanded frame。
connectivity.consumer: CloudWholeTaskObserver 分类 demanded frame、发布唯一 PreparedDialogAction 与 PREPARED_ACTION_READY；FiveRingTaskV2 仅消费当前 exact action，并在点击后等待 Title 确认。
connectivity.ordering: NPC FIFO VERIFIED -> arm Wuhuan presence interests -> install phase-owned DialogInterest -> dialog presence -> unique FrameDemand -> exact frame -> PreparedAction -> PREPARED_ACTION_READY -> option click -> Title confirmation

proves: direct accept path arms Wuhuan presence before installing DialogInterest
Cloud observer turns presence into the wuhuan-dialog demand and PreparedAction
the task wakes only through PREPARED_ACTION_READY before consuming the option action
